titulo: $100 a Month at 20 or $400 a Month at 40? 💰
descripcion: Maya saves $100 a month from 20 to 65. Jake saves $400 a month from 40 to 65. Both earn the same 7% average yearly return, compounded monthly. Future value of monthly savings: FV = P × ((1 + r)^n − 1) / r, with r = 0.07/12. Maya: 540 months → ≈ $379,259 (she puts in $54,000). Jake: 300 months → $200 ≈ $162,014 · $400 ≈ $324,029 · $450 ≈ $364,532 · $470 ≈ $380,734 (he puts in $141,000). Break-even ≈ $468 a month. Her first dollar compounds for 45 years, his for 25. When did you start? Illustration only, assumes a constant 7% average return; not financial advice. #shorts #money #investing #compoundinterest
